scripts.translation: 我的宠物跑到村子外面去了~！！

scripts.text: The day is not finished yet.
You can only help once a day. Hehe.
scripts.translation: 每天只能帮忙一次哦。呵呵。

scripts.text: My pets are in the field outside of the village.
scripts.translation: 我的宠物在村子外面的田野里。

scripts.text: Why did they leave? Please find them.
scripts.translation: 它们为什么跑掉了呢？请帮我找到它们。

scripts.text: Oh, thank you. You found all of 3 puppies.
scripts.translation: 哦，谢谢你！你把3只小狗都找回来了。

scripts.text: I hope this is useful to you. hoho.
scripts.translation: 希望这点心意能帮到你。呵呵。

scripts.text: Are you an adventurer? You came here right on time.
scripts.translation: 你是冒险者吗？你来得正是时候。

scripts.text: And someone said that they saw them out on the field just outside the village....
scripts.translation: 有人说在村外的田野里见过它们...

scripts.text: It's pretty difficult and dangerous to find 'em.
scripts.translation: 找到它们相当困难且危险。
很好。我找到了全部3只小狗。

scripts.text: Now I need to go tell Angelo.
scripts.translation: 现在我要去告诉安杰洛。
好吧，其他的小狗在哪里？

scripts.text: Have you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
scripts.translation: 你是来打^FF0000变异海葵^000000的吗？

scripts.text: Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
scripts.translation: 用它捕捉一只^FF0000变异海葵^8B4513。^000000

scripts.text: I hope you can do it~!
came here and surrounded the town.
scripts.translation: 来到了这里，把城镇团团包围。

scripts.text: We're not sure what attracted them but some say that it's because of you adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我们不确定是什么吸引了它们，但有人说是因为你们这些冒险者。

scripts.text: In any case, to contain the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s,
you have to use this specially designed tool a.k.a. a ^8B4513Hydra Ball^000000
scripts.translation: 必须使用这种特别设计的工具，也就是^8B4513海葵球^000000。

scripts.text: If you still have the ^006400Hydra Ball^000000,
please use it on the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s that
scripts.translation: 请用它对付那些^FF0000变异海葵^000000，

scripts.text: you can find at the beach.
If you are lucky, the tool will work perfectly.
scripts.translation: 运气好的话，这个工具就能顺利发挥作用。

scripts.text: Please make room and come back!

scripts.translation: 你还需要另一个^006400海葵球^000000吗？

scripts.text: I will give you one more.
Ok, please do me a favor.
I'm so grateful for your help.
Please come at the appropriate time.
Did you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
scripts.translation: 你是来这里打^FF0000变异海葵^000000的吗？

scripts.text: Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
I hope you can do it~!
- You can't start the quest. Please reduce the weight in your inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 无法开始任务。请减轻背包重量。 -

scripts.text: Yo, do you know a berry called ^FF0000Guarana^000000?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你知道一种叫^FF0000瓜拉那^000000的浆果吗？

scripts.text: Guarana is a really special berry raised in a specific area, it relieves physical fatigue, and gives power to the body. It even detoxes waste from the body.
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那是一种在特定地区种植的特殊浆果，它能缓解身体疲劳，为身体提供能量，甚至能排出体内的毒素。

scripts.text: I used to sell the candy made of it back in the day.
scripts.translation: 我以前卖用瓜拉那做的糖果。

scripts.text: I got a prize sometimes every year in the <annual best product contest>. Those were the good 'ol days.
scripts.translation: 几乎每年都能在“年度最佳产品大赛”中获奖。那真是段美好时光。

scripts.text: Since then, the output of that fruit has reduced and the price has gone up so now candy ingredients were changed to coconuts or other tropical fruits instead. I miss the guarana candy.
scripts.translation: 后来瓜拉那产量减少、价格上涨，如今糖果改用椰子或其他热带水果制作。我真怀念瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text: How can I taste this guarana candy?
scripts.translation: 我怎么才能尝到这种瓜拉那糖？

scripts.text: Hmm? I already sold out of all my old supply.
scripts.translation: 嗯？我以前的存货已经卖光了。

scripts.text: But if you can find some guarana, I can make it for you.
scripts.translation: 但如果你能找到一些瓜拉那，我可以为你制作。

scripts.text: Will you find the guarana?? Hoooooh~
scripts.translation: 你要去找瓜拉那吗？哇哦~

scripts.text: Trading isn't my thing. Let me think.
scripts.translation: 我不擅长做生意。让我想想办法。

scripts.text: Let me introduce you to someone with whom I used to do guarana business with.
scripts.translation: 让我介绍你认识一个人，我以前和他做过瓜拉那的生意。

scripts.text: He might still be dealing it.
scripts.translation: 他可能还在做这门生意。

scripts.text: If you can't find him in the city, go to museum.
scripts.translation: 如果在城里找不到他，就去博物馆看看。

scripts.text: He's a vain person so he likes to act big.
scripts.translation: 他很爱慕虚荣，喜欢摆架子。

scripts.text: He's probably wandering in the museum trying to show off to someone for sure.
scripts.translation: 他肯定正在博物馆里四处游荡，向别人炫耀自己。

scripts.text: Don't you want to try the guarana candy?
scripts.translation: 你不想尝尝瓜拉那糖吗？
那是多么美好的时光啊...

scripts.text: If you want to get the guarana, find Cherto.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要瓜拉那，去找切尔托。

scripts.text: Maybe he will be in the museum.
- The guarana that I had has disappeared. -
scripts.translation: - 我带着的瓜拉那不见了。 -

scripts.text: - You give the guarana to him. -
It's the best thing I have ever seen so far. Cool~!
scripts.translation: 这是我见过最棒的作品。太酷了~！

scripts.text: Long time no see my wonderful guarana candy...
scripts.translation: 好久没做我最爱的瓜拉那糖了...

scripts.text: - hash hash hash hash hash hash -
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
Look! It's the popular guarana candy.
scripts.translation: 看！这就是人气瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text: Try to savor its amazing taste hey~ take it easy. hahaha!!
scripts.translation: 好好尝尝它的美妙滋味...慢慢来。哈哈哈！！

scripts.text: Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那糖。这绝对是我一生中独一无二的杰作！

scripts.text: Since you helped me, guarana supply has been steadily rising.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你帮忙，瓜拉那的供应一直稳步增加。

scripts.text: So, naturally I'm back to making guarana candy.
scripts.translation: 所以，我自然而然地重新开始制作瓜拉那糖了。

scripts.text: What about it? Wanna buy some?
Here is a delicious guarana candy.
scripts.translation: 这是一块美味的瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text: What? You should say before if you don't have money!
scripts.translation: 什么？没钱你应该早点说啊！

scripts.text: Even if you are poor, I can't give this away for free.
scripts.translation: 就算你穷，我也不能免费送你。

scripts.text: Sometimes some people don't like it due to it's arousal effect.
scripts.translation: 有些人不喜欢它，因为吃了会兴奋。

scripts.text: Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那糖。这绝对是我一生中独一无二的杰作！

scripts.text: Hmm... hey man, you are from outside, aren't you?
scripts.translation: 嗯...嘿，伙计，你是外地人吧？

scripts.text: Cherto can figure it out even if it's the first time. You can't trick Cherto.
scripts.translation: 切尔托一眼就能看出来！你骗不了切尔托。

scripts.text: Cherto has sharp eyes like an eagle! Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 切尔托有一双鹰眼！哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Ok, ok. Yes, yes. I see!
scripts.translation: 好的，好的。是的，是的。我明白了！

scripts.text: Anyway, you arrived in Brasilis but don't know what to do?
scripts.translation: 总之，你来到巴西，却不知道该做什么？

scripts.text: You don't know how fortunate you are to have found a really proper helper as myself.
scripts.translation: 你真幸运，遇到了我这样可靠的帮手。

scripts.text: Cherto takes it by your expression that you want to say, ''You are a master!'' Right?
scripts.translation: 切尔托从你的表情看出，你想说：“你真是大师！”对吧？

scripts.text: Cherto, I can read and figure out all at once! That is written in your face!
scripts.translation: 切尔托一眼就能看穿一切，你的心思全写在脸上了！

scripts.text: Cherto would love to stay here and explain everything to you but he is a busy man.
scripts.translation: 切尔托本想留在这里给你解释一切，但切尔托是个大忙人。

scripts.text: If you have a curious thing to ask to Cherto. Cherto will be kind enough to answer.
scripts.translation: 如果你有什么问题想问切尔托，切尔托会很乐意回答。

scripts.text: What? Do you want to find a guarana?
Guarana is only raised in this area, it has a soft inside and is coverd with a light fur.
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那只生长在这一带，果肉柔软，外面覆着浅色绒毛。

scripts.text: It seems a little bit weird but the flower is really big and smells beautiful.
scripts.translation: 看起来有点奇特，但它的花很大，香气也很迷人。

scripts.text: A long time ago, guarana was used to relieve desease and thirst. But recently it's getting popular to revitalize body power and increase blood circulation.
scripts.translation: 以前，瓜拉那用来治病解渴。最近则因为能恢复体力、促进血液循环而大受欢迎。

scripts.text: Although it has such great effects, Cherto is sorry to inform you that we can't get it anymore.
scripts.translation: 虽然它有这么好的功效，但很遗憾地通知你，我们现在已经买不到了。

scripts.text: For a while now, guarana berries haven't been growing here.
scripts.translation: 这段时间以来，这里都没再长出瓜拉那。

scripts.text: Even if Cherto managed to find one, it will rot quickly.
scripts.translation: 就算切尔托找到一颗，它也会很快腐烂。
要是没发生这种事就好了！

scripts.text: This story has been forbidden! Someone might be listening to our conversation...
scripts.translation: 这个故事是禁忌！说不定有人正在偷听...

scripts.text: If Cherto tells you, you might get us into trouble. But you look like you really wanna know so let me give you a tip.
scripts.translation: 切尔托要是告诉你，可能会惹上麻烦。不过看你真的很想知道，我就给你一点提示。

scripts.text: Come closer. Cherto will whisper so nobody can listen in.
scripts.translation: 靠近些，我小声告诉你，免得被别人听见。
一个瓜拉那男孩出生了。

scripts.text: There was woman who was an expert botanist.
scripts.translation: 有一位精通植物学的女子。

scripts.text: The woman was really popular to all living creatures.
scripts.translation: 她深受所有生灵的喜爱。

scripts.text: At around the time her baby was born, she started a guarana farm. For some reason, her brothers were jealous so they destroyed the farm and disappeared.
scripts.translation: 她生下孩子前后，开始种植瓜拉那。不知为何，她的兄弟们嫉妒她，毁掉了农场后便消失了。

scripts.text: We can't be sure that baby was born in the world but since that time, all guarana in Brasilis disappeared.
scripts.translation: 我们无法确定那个孩子是否真的出生了，但从那时起，巴西的瓜拉那就全都消失了。
那个瓜拉那小孩究竟是谁？

scripts.text: Pedro who is famous as a greedy man?
Meto who can't endure about all the fruits?
scripts.translation: 是忍不住要吃水果的梅托？
还是总是闷闷不乐的霍维纽？

scripts.text: Will you figure out it? hohohhhhh~
Can you find the guarana kid?
scripts.translation: 你能找到瓜拉那小孩吗？
你找到瓜拉那小孩了吗？

scripts.text: - I tell Cherto about the kid making animal-like sounds. -
scripts.translation: - 告诉切尔托那个发出像动物叫声的小孩。 -

scripts.text: That kid might be a guarana kid. Sure...
scripts.translation: 那个孩子可能就是瓜拉那小孩。没错...

scripts.text: According to the story the kid can have conversations with animals.
If he can make crying sounds of animals, they might be able to converse!
scripts.translation: 如果他能模仿动物叫声，说不定就能和它们交流！

scripts.text: If he is the kid from the legend, is there any way to raise the guarana again?
scripts.translation: 如果他是传说中的那个小孩，有什么办法能重新种植瓜拉那吗？
哈哈！！切尔托说什么来着？

scripts.text: In Brasilis there is an expert Mage.
scripts.translation: 在巴西有一位精通魔法的专家。

scripts.text: Take this note over to him.
He will show the solution for you and the kid.
scripts.translation: 他会为你和那个小孩找出解决办法。

scripts.text: What can I say to him?
chamber pot braeee chamber pot brae chamber pot brae -
He makes strange sound like an animals.
scripts.translation: 他发出像动物一样的奇怪叫声。

scripts.text: Should I ask advice from Cherto?
He makes strange sounds like an animal.
scripts.translation: 他发出像动物一样的奇怪声音。

scripts.text: Should I ask advice from Cherto?
scripts.translation: 我应该去问问切尔托吗？

scripts.text: I don't have a story but there are lots of friends waiting outside.
scripts.translation: 我不会讲故事，不过外面有很多朋友在等你。

scripts.text: - You give the feather, fresh meat and branch of grapes to the kid -
scripts.translation: - 你给了小孩羽毛、新鲜肉和葡萄枝 -

scripts.text: kkk yes. Lots of friends want to meet you.
scripts.translation: 对了，外面有好多朋友想见你。

scripts.text: Don't be lonely anymore and be happy with your friends.
scripts.translation: 别再孤单了，和朋友们在一起，开心起来吧。

scripts.text: - He starts to smile lightly and laughs. -
scripts.translation: - 他微微一笑，又轻声笑了起来。 -

scripts.text: Be a happy kid as always.
scripts.translation: 要一直做个快乐的孩子哦。

scripts.text: Do you want to say anything?
- You get closer and pretend to take caution. -
scripts.translation: - 你走近他，装作小心翼翼的样子。 -

scripts.text: - The kid laughs again lightly then puts something in your hand. -
scripts.translation: - 小孩再次轻轻笑了起来，然后往你手里放了什么东西。 -

scripts.text: - It's a fresh berry that's colored red and hard. -
scripts.translation: - 这是一种红色的、坚硬的新鲜浆果。 -

scripts.text: If I have this, I can make a guarana candy.
scripts.translation: 有了这个，我就能制作瓜拉那糖了。

scripts.text: I better find that Candy Maker!
Hello. Mr. Cherto told me to find you.
scripts.translation: 你好。切尔托先生让我来找你。

scripts.text: Have you come here to ask about lots of weird rumors?
scripts.translation: 你是来打听那些奇怪传闻的吗？

scripts.text: - You give the note to Paje-

scripts.translation: 嗯，天哪...原来发生了这种事。

scripts.text: But I will give you simple magic so you can figure it out by yourself.
scripts.translation: 不过我可以教你一个简单的魔法，让你自己查明真相。

scripts.text: It's a magic that will make you appear as an animal to other animals. Pretty cool huh?
scripts.translation: 这是一种能让其他动物把你当成同类的魔法。很酷吧？

scripts.text: Ok~ I will give you the magic.
Most animals are really sensitive so they might be aware of it. Find a Toucan in the field that's oblivious to the spell. You'll know when you talk to it.
scripts.translation: 大多数动物都很敏锐，可能会察觉到法术。去田野里找一只没察觉到法术的巨嘴鸟。和它交谈时你就知道了。

scripts.text: It's the middle of the new and old continent... I know I've never seen you before but you seem familiar, like a woman dancing a samba.
scripts.translation: 这里是新旧大陆的交界处...我确定以前没见过你，但你又让我觉得眼熟，就像一位跳桑巴舞的女子。

scripts.text: I can feel some similar power like guarana kid. bbaaaeeeccc!
scripts.translation: 我能感觉到一种和瓜拉那小孩相似的力量。咿呀咿呀！

scripts.text: That kid has had a really lonely time, baaecc! Perhaps you are a friend of him? Baaeec!!
scripts.translation: 那孩子一直很孤独，咿呀！你是他的朋友吗？咿呀！！

scripts.text: Not yet... but I want to be a friend.
scripts.translation: 还不是...但我想成为他的朋友

scripts.text: The kid who received care from guarana woman is also a friend of animals. Bbaaeecc!
scripts.translation: 那个受到瓜拉那女子照顾的小孩，也是动物的朋友。Bbaaeecc!

scripts.text: I'd like to give the symbol of a toucan representative for the kid. Bbaaeecc!
scripts.translation: 我想把巨嘴鸟的信物送给那个孩子。咿呀！

scripts.text: If you want to relieve his loneliness, can you help me?
scripts.translation: 如果你想缓解他的孤独，能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: We will keep our promise of friendship between guarana kid and Toucan forever. Bbaaeecc!
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那小孩和巨嘴鸟会永远是朋友。咿呀！

scripts.text: - You take a feather from Toucan. -
scripts.translation: - 你从巨嘴鸟那里拿到了一根羽毛。 -

scripts.text: There have to be others around here like me.
scripts.translation: 这附近肯定还有像我这样的同伴。

scripts.text: Why don't you find a jaguar Bbaaeecc!
I will give a blessing from Toucan to you.
scripts.translation: 我会给你巨嘴鸟的祝福。

scripts.text: Smelling! This smell is from a human!
scripts.translation: 嗅到了！这是人类的气味！

scripts.text: I don't have enough power to hunt humans, just waiting time to end my lifetime in this jungle.
scripts.translation: 我已经没有力气捕猎人类了，只能在这片丛林里等待生命走到尽头。

scripts.text: Anyway you can talk with me, are you a guarana kid?
scripts.translation: 话说回来，你能和我交谈...你是瓜拉那小孩吗？

scripts.text: The son of guarana woman became our friend also.
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那女子的儿子也成了我们的朋友。

scripts.text: I hope you are same the as her.
The son of guarana woman has a diseased heart.
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那女子的儿子心灵受了伤。

scripts.text: Her brothers made him lonely, don't you think?
scripts.translation: 他的兄弟们让他感到孤独，不是吗？

scripts.text: Here is fresh meat that I hunted just a few days ago.
scripts.translation: 这是我前几天刚猎到的新鲜肉。

scripts.text: Take it and give it to the poor kid.
scripts.translation: 拿去吧，给那个可怜的小孩。

scripts.text: I can give this tiny thing to you so, don't forget it.
scripts.translation: 我把这件小东西送给你，别忘了哦。

scripts.text: The jungle will welcome you whenever!
scripts.translation: 丛林随时欢迎你的到来！

scripts.text: - You get fresh meat from Jaguar. -
scripts.translation: - 你从美洲豹那里获得了新鲜肉。 -

scripts.text: Monkey, who's always meddling with others, wants to meet you.
scripts.translation: 总是爱管闲事的猴子想见你。

scripts.text: I will give you a Jaguar's high blessing.
scripts.translation: 我将赐予你美洲豹的祝福。

scripts.text: Go to monkey by flowing through the wind like a bee.
scripts.translation: 像蜜蜂乘风飞舞那样，去找猴子吧。

scripts.text: We don't tolerate humans? Get out~!!
scripts.translation: 我们不容忍人类！滚出去~！！

scripts.text: I can smell Jaguar from you, who are you?
scripts.translation: 我从你身上闻到了美洲豹的味道。你是谁？

scripts.text: Gosh, maybe there's no jaguar without fur and weird shape!
scripts.translation: 天哪，美洲豹哪有没毛还长得这么奇怪的！

scripts.text: Are you saying that I look like an animal?!?!
scripts.translation: 你是说我看起来像动物吗？！

scripts.text: Ahhha. Jaguar send you to me, right?? kkkikkki
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈，美洲豹派你来的，对吧？嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text: But you don't look like guarana kid.
scripts.translation: 不过你看起来不像瓜拉那小孩。

scripts.text: I've come here to help him.
I heard guarana kid became lonely, is he?
scripts.translation: 我听说瓜拉那小孩很孤独，是吗？

scripts.text: We are experts in acrobatic acts, does kid like it?? kkkickkksk!
scripts.translation: 我们最擅长表演杂技，他会喜欢吗？嘻嘻嘻！

scripts.text: Give this branch of grapes to guarana kid.
scripts.translation: 把这串葡萄送给瓜拉那小孩。

scripts.text: We will make him have fun during the whole night whenever he comes to us!! kkkickkksk!
scripts.translation: 他来找我们时，我们会陪他玩个通宵！嘻嘻嘻！

scripts.text: - You get a bunch of grapes from Monkey. -
scripts.translation: - 你从猴子那里获得了一串葡萄。 -

scripts.text: Good~ Now it's time to go back to the kid~!!
scripts.translation: 好~ 现在该回去找那个小孩了~！！

scripts.text: This climate offers special cases in botany classes different from any other regions of the world.
scripts.translation: 这里的植物种类也与世界其他地区截然不同。

scripts.text: The plants here have robust frames and are clear and colorful.
scripts.translation: 这里的植物枝干粗壮，色彩鲜明艳丽。

scripts.text: Here the plants are really huge and we can feel their presence.
scripts.translation: 植物长得十分高大，存在感十足。

scripts.text: One of them, a Water Lily, is a really gorgeous and unique plant.
scripts.translation: 其中一种是睡莲，既美丽又独特。

scripts.text: This flower is quite sensitive so it doesn't bloom everywhere.
scripts.translation: 这种花对环境很挑剔，并非随处都能开花。

scripts.text: I guess you aren't interested in botany.
scripts.translation: 看来你对植物学不感兴趣呢。

scripts.text: It doesn't appear easily and it is a mysterious flower even to the natives, so the Brasilis people believe that a person will get great luck if someone finds it.
scripts.translation: 这种花很罕见，连当地人也觉得神秘，所以巴西人相信，找到它的人会交上好运。

scripts.text: As a botanist, I have been hanging around here to find the lucky flower but as I expected, it hasn't shown itself yet.
scripts.translation: 作为植物学家，我一直在这里寻找这朵幸运之花，但它至今仍未现身。

scripts.text: I believe that with enough perseverence, this flower will show me it's beautiful brilliance.
scripts.translation: 我相信只要坚持下去，这朵花终会展现它美丽的光彩。

scripts.text: Ah, if you are interested more in the Water Lily story, find someone named Marta.
scripts.translation: 如果你想多听些关于睡莲的故事，可以去找玛尔塔。

scripts.text: She is wise and knows lots of stories here in Brasilis.
scripts.translation: 她很有智慧，也熟知巴西的各种传说。

scripts.text: Ah, if you are interested more in the Water Lily story, find someone named Marta.
scripts.translation: 啊，如果你更想听关于莲花的故事，去找一个叫玛尔塔的人吧。

scripts.text: She is wise and knows lots of stories here in Brasilis.
scripts.translation: 她很有智慧，知道巴西这里很多故事。

scripts.text: - You show a lotus flower to Karmen and talk about the story so far. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卡门展示了一朵莲花，并讲述了迄今为止的故事。 -

scripts.text: Wow!! You had a really good experience.
So~~~ the water lily lives in the depths of brasilis, right?
scripts.translation: 所以~~~睡莲生长在巴西深处，对吧？

scripts.text: I wil try to find it again by myself, I won't give up!!
scripts.translation: 我会继续自己寻找，绝不会放弃！！

scripts.text: I am so grateful that I met you.
The water lily must truly be a lucky flower. hahaha
scripts.translation: 莲花一定真的是朵幸运之花。哈哈哈

scripts.text: This climate offers special cases in botany classes different from any other regions of the world.
scripts.translation: 这种气候造就了植物学上独特的案例，与世界上其他任何地区都不同。

scripts.text: The plants here have robust frames and are clear and colorful.
scripts.translation: 这里的植物枝干粗壮，色彩鲜明艳丽。

scripts.text: Here the plants are really huge and we can feel their presence.
scripts.translation: 它们长得十分高大，存在感十足。

scripts.text: Grandma! That person has a weird smell.
scripts.translation: 奶奶！那个人身上有股怪味。
跟我们的客人打个招呼吧。

scripts.text: The outsider has a weird name!
Thas ok! If we keep talking we'll be friends! Cheer up!
scripts.translation: 不过没关系！多聊几句就能成为朋友！打起精神来！

scripts.text: So, why have you come here stranger~?
scripts.translation: 那么，陌生人，你为什么来这里呢~？

scripts.text: I heard you knows lots of stories, is that true?
scripts.translation: 我听说你知道很多故事，是真的吗？

scripts.text: Wooo! how you know my grandma knows lots of stories, amazing~?
scripts.translation: 哇！你怎么知道我奶奶很会讲故事？好厉害~

scripts.text: Grandma is really wise and kind so, I heard lotsa things.
scripts.translation: 奶奶聪明又善良，所以我听她讲了好多故事。

scripts.text: Hehe. Kaka always listens to many stories every night, he really likes my stories.
scripts.translation: 呵呵，卡卡每晚都听我讲故事，他最喜欢这些故事了。

scripts.text: Kaka always makes me happy because he asks so many curious things. That is pure happiness.
scripts.translation: 他总是问我各种有趣的问题，让我很开心。这就是最简单的幸福。

scripts.text: Ok, Kaka why don't you invite our guest today to our small meeting?
scripts.translation: 卡卡，今天也邀请这位客人来参加我们的小聚会吧？

scripts.text: Hey~ do you have special story that you want to listen to?
scripts.translation: 嘿~你想听什么特别的故事？

scripts.text: It's from a long long time ago.
scripts.translation: 那是很久很久以前的事了。

scripts.text: A tribe that lived with the giant waterfall and jungle as friends spent their whole time with nature.
scripts.translation: 有个部落与巨大的瀑布和丛林为伴，一直过着亲近自然的生活。

scripts.text: One of tribe chiefs had a pretty daughter called 'Naia'.
scripts.translation: 部落首领有一个美丽的女儿，名叫“奈亚”。

scripts.text: Naia liked listening to stories like Kaka so, her mom told her stories every night about nature and gods.
scripts.translation: 奈亚和卡卡一样喜欢听故事，所以她的母亲每晚都会给她讲自然与神灵的故事。

scripts.text: Maybe she would be pretty... hehe.
If the moon in the sky loves some woman in the earth, he turns her into a star so that they can stay together forever.
scripts.translation: 如果天上的月亮爱上地上的女子，就会把她变成星星，让两人永远相伴。

scripts.text: After Naia heard this story, she went to her dad to ask if it was true or not.
scripts.translation: 奈亚听完这个故事后，去找爸爸问这是不是真的。

scripts.text: ^3131FF'My dear, Naia the moon is one of the bravest men. But he can no longer have a bride. So you can't become a star... Sorry~.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF“亲爱的奈亚，月亮是最勇敢的男人之一，但他已经不能再娶新娘了。所以你无法成为星星...对不起~。”^000000

scripts.text: Did Naia wants to be the bride of the man?
scripts.translation: 奈亚想嫁给那个男人吗？

scripts.text: Yes Kaka, imagine the moon how beautiful and mysterious, that's just ideal for girls.
scripts.translation: 是啊，卡卡。想想看，月亮多么美丽又神秘，对女孩来说简直是理想对象。

scripts.text: But the moon doesn't meet a human as his wife anymore? What was going on with Naia?
scripts.translation: 可是月亮不再娶人类做妻子了吗？奈亚后来怎么样了？

scripts.text: Naia was really a nice girl.
scripts.translation: 奈亚真的是个很好的女孩。

scripts.text: Although her parents tried to prevent her, she still went to the forest to meet the moon every night.
scripts.translation: 尽管父母试图阻止她，她还是每晚都去森林里见月亮。

scripts.text: Sadly, even with all of her effort, the moon didn't show any reaction to her.
scripts.translation: 可惜无论她多努力，月亮都没有回应她。

scripts.text: One day she also went to the top of the mountain to be closer to him. She decided to take a rest for a while around the lake.
scripts.translation: 有一天，她也爬到了山顶，为了离他更近一些。她决定在湖边休息一会儿。

scripts.text: It was the moon he was shining beautifully over the waving lake lightly.
scripts.translation: 月亮的光芒映在微微荡漾的湖面上，显得格外美丽。

scripts.text: I know, it's just the moon reflecting on the water. Right?!
scripts.translation: 我知道，那只是月亮在水中的倒影。对吧？！

scripts.text: Yes, but to her, the image made her fall into the lake without hesitating and drowned.
scripts.translation: 没错。但她看着那倒影，毫不犹豫地跳进湖里，结果溺水身亡。

scripts.text: The moon was also watching her from the sky.
scripts.translation: 月亮也在天空中注视着她。

scripts.text: He felt sad and pitied her. So he decided to turn her into a beautiful flower to thank her for her love.
scripts.translation: 他感到悲伤，也怜悯她。为了回应她的爱，他决定把她变成一朵美丽的花。

scripts.text: That is the story of the mysterious flower people called the Brasilis Water Flower.
scripts.translation: 这就是巴西水花的传说。

scripts.text: This Naia flower appears as light white during daytime but in the night turns into red due to it's love connection to the moon.
scripts.translation: 这种奈亚花白天呈淡白色，到了夜晚，因为与月亮相连的爱意而变成红色。

scripts.text: If you want to listen to another story, just come to me.
scripts.translation: 还想听别的故事的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text: If you don't mind playing with my grandson a ~ little. hoohoo.
scripts.translation: 如果你不介意的话，陪我孙子玩一会儿吧~呵呵。

scripts.text: My grandma is really a bit tired doing some tribe stuff!
scripts.translation: 奶奶忙部落里的事，累坏了！

scripts.text: You are not from around here.
I can sense a strange earth smell.
scripts.translation: 我能闻到你身上陌生的气息。

scripts.text: But your eyes shine with strength.
scripts.translation: 不过，你眼中闪烁着力量。

scripts.text: Indeed you are spreading out spirit and will from your whole body.
scripts.translation: 你的全身都散发着精神与意志。

scripts.text: If you work at it you will be a great person someday.
scripts.translation: 如果你努力的话，总有一天你会成为一个伟大的人。

scripts.text: - so you can't get any more items. -
Mom, I have to go out!!
What's up? Why are you looking at me?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？为什么盯着我看？

scripts.text: I don't want to be a showgirl!! Get out!!
scripts.translation: 我才不想当舞女！！快走开！！

scripts.text: What's it matter to you that I'm rude??!!
I know that I'm just passing by but I might be able to help you. What do you think?
scripts.translation: 我知道自己只是路过，但也许能帮到你。你觉得呢？

scripts.text: This kind of meeting could be more than just a coincidence.
scripts.translation: 这次相遇或许并非巧合。

scripts.text: Hmm can you tell me your name?
scripts.translation: 嗯，能告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text: I have to meet 'Jasi' but I can't go out....
scripts.translation: 我要去见“雅西”，但我不能出门...

scripts.text: If he is my lover, it would be great... but...
scripts.translation: 如果他是我的恋人就好了...但是...

scripts.text: Maybe... are you talking about the moon from the story?
scripts.translation: 难道...你说的是故事里的月亮？

scripts.text: Dear Jasi is from the moon from the sky!
scripts.translation: 亲爱的雅西来自天空中的月亮！

scripts.text: Why are you thinking like that?
Cuz' Jasi is really gorgeous and the most important thing is he is taking care of the water lily in Brasilis.
scripts.translation: 因为雅西真的很英俊，更重要的是，他照料着巴西的睡莲。
那不是一种独特的花吗？

scripts.text: Right. It's a really mysterious flower and difficult to find.
scripts.translation: 没错。那是一种很神奇的花，很难找到。

scripts.text: But around Jasi there are lots of water lilies.
scripts.translation: 但在雅西身边有很多莲花。

scripts.text: That's why I believe Jasi is the moon.
scripts.translation: 所以我相信雅西就是月亮。

scripts.text: He is deep inside the Jungle.
As you can see I am so weak so, I've been staying home. But once, I was strong enough to leave this village.
scripts.translation: 你看，我现在很虚弱，只能待在家里。不过以前我身体好时，也能离开村子。

scripts.text: I just wandered the jungle and fell down somewhere and that's where I saw him.
scripts.translation: 我在丛林里闲逛，不知怎么摔了一跤，就在那里遇见了他。

scripts.text: He was so nice. He helped heal me and guided me back home.
scripts.translation: 他人很好，帮我疗伤，还带我回家。

scripts.text: That was really really great time.
scripts.translation: 那真是一段美好的时光。

scripts.text: Since I came back home, my parents punished me.
I can understand why they are worrying but i missed Jasi a lot!
scripts.translation: 我明白他们为何担心，可我太想念雅西了！

scripts.text: Why don't you meet him after recovering your strength?
scripts.translation: 等你恢复体力后再去见他，怎么样？

scripts.text: I wanna see him right now...
Sorry I can't help you. Cheer up!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我帮不了你。振作点！

scripts.text: Jasira I came here to find the Brasilis water lily.
scripts.translation: 雅西拉，我来这里是为了寻找巴西睡莲。

scripts.text: Don't you think fate has brought us together?
scripts.translation: 你不觉得我们相遇是命运的安排吗？

scripts.text: If you tell me how to find Jasi, I can help you.
scripts.translation: 如果你告诉我怎么找到雅西，我就可以帮你。

scripts.text: Really? But I don't know exactly how to get there. I was just wandering around when I met him.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？但我不知道确切的路怎么走。我只是在闲逛时遇见他的。

scripts.text: If you know something you've gotta tell me.
scripts.translation: 如果你知道什么，一定要告诉我。

scripts.text: Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
scripts.translation: 让我想想...我当时在瀑布附近闲逛，后来掉进水里，被水流卷到了某个地方。

scripts.text: Good, that's better than nothing! I will look for a similar place.
scripts.translation: 很好，总比没有线索强！我会去找找类似的地方。

scripts.text: I gave you your information, so can you do me a favor?
scripts.translation: 我把情报都告诉你了，你能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text: I'd like to give a delicious fruit.
scripts.translation: 我想送他一些好吃的水果。

scripts.text: The place where Jas seemed cozy but I didn't see any food around... So if he sees a yummy fruit he will be happy!
scripts.translation: 雅西住的地方很舒适，可附近似乎没有食物...要是他看到美味的水果，一定会很开心！

scripts.text: Give him 10 Banana and tell him that I really miss him.
scripts.translation: 给他10个香蕉，并告诉他我很想念他。

scripts.text: Sorry for ignoring you before. Please, only you can help me!
scripts.translation: 抱歉之前忽略了你。拜托了，只有你能帮到我！

scripts.text: If you meet Jasi, give him 10 Bananas.
scripts.translation: 见到雅西的话，给他10个香蕉。

scripts.text: Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
scripts.translation: 让我想想...我当时在瀑布附近闲逛，后来掉进水里，被水流卷到了某个地方。

scripts.text: If you can't find the way, go up to the waterfall and ask the kids in Brasilis village.
scripts.translation: 如果你找不到路，就去瀑布那里问问巴西村庄的小孩。

scripts.text: I heard one of the children went to a strange place before. He might've gone to the same place as me!
scripts.translation: 我听说有个孩子之前去过一个奇怪的地方。他可能和我去了同一个地方！

scripts.text: Hey girl~ you've got a short temper.
I did see him and I talked about you!
scripts.translation: 我见到他了，也告诉他你的事了！

scripts.text: That you have a really good heart~
I told him that you will try to meet him when your condition gets better.
scripts.translation: 我告诉他，等你身体好转，就会去见他。

scripts.text: Thank you! You are more reliable than I thought you would be.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你！你比我想象的更可靠呢。

scripts.text: Anyway, I'm looking for a fruit that's brown and has a hard shell.
scripts.translation: 对了，我在找一种棕色、外壳很硬的水果。

scripts.text: It has juice inside and can be used as a cup to drink out of.
scripts.translation: 里面有很多汁水，可以当杯子用来喝水。

scripts.text: Duh! You mean a coconut right?!
I should take care of my strength by myself!
scripts.translation: 我应该自己努力恢复体力！

scripts.text: I can't just lie in my bed forever. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation: 不能一直躺在床上。你觉得呢？

scripts.text: Uh? Why have you come back?
- You tell her what Jasi told you to tell her -
scripts.translation: - 告诉她雅西让你转达的话 -

scripts.text: Thanks to you, I was able to get a flower.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，我拿到了一朵花。

scripts.text: Ah... can I see it for a second?
I've been working on this hat while you were gone and now it's complete with the water lily flower!
scripts.translation: 趁你不在的时候，我一直在做这顶帽子，现在配上莲花就完工了！

scripts.text: I know, I know! I'm the best...
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道！我是最棒的...

scripts.text: I just need to get a little bit stronger!
I can't just lie in bed forever. My Jasi is waiting for me~
scripts.translation: 不能一直躺在床上。我的雅西在等着我呢~

scripts.text: Oh, I haven't seen another person in such a long time.
scripts.translation: 好久没有见到其他人了。

scripts.text: You don't have specific business with me.
scripts.translation: 你并没有特别的事情要找我。

scripts.text: My family has worked to take care of the water lily from generation to generation.
scripts.translation: 我家世世代代都在照料莲花。

scripts.text: Basically the Brasilis water lily is too shy to appear in front of people so, they only bloom in rare places. I guess they like it here, though, that's why I've been staying here for such a long time.
scripts.translation: 巴西莲花十分害羞，很少在人前出现，只有在少数地方才会开花。我想它们很喜欢这里，所以我在这里待了这么久。

scripts.text: My family has taken care of the water lily calmly to prevent harm from people's hand or monsters.
scripts.translation: 我家世世代代都在照料莲花，保护它们免受人类和魔物的伤害。

scripts.text: Do you remember a girl named Jasi.
scripts.translation: 你还记得一个叫雅西的女孩吗？

scripts.text: Gosh.. I was in trouble due to that girl.
scripts.translation: 天哪...因为那个女孩，我差点陷入麻烦。

scripts.text: One day a young lady appeared with lots of scars so I helped her. Then suddenly she tried to pick up the water lily and asked me to accept her as my wife or make her into a water lily what a nutcase!
scripts.translation: 有一天，一位满身伤痕的年轻女士出现了，我帮助了她。然后她突然想摘走莲花，并要求我娶她为妻，或者把她变成一朵莲花，真是个疯子！

scripts.text: I was barely able to calm down and send her to the village.
scripts.translation: 我好不容易才让她冷静下来，把她送回了村庄。

scripts.text: My life is that water lily so I didn't want anything embarrassing to happen.
scripts.translation: 我的生命就是这朵莲花，我不想发生任何尴尬的事情。

scripts.text: This is a gift from Jasira to say sorry for that time.
scripts.translation: 这是雅西拉寄来的礼物，为了那件事道歉。

scripts.text: She is really sad that can't come here by herself due to private difficulties.
scripts.translation: 她因为私事无法亲自前来，感到非常难过。

scripts.text: - Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
scripts.translation: - 哦对了，我忘了带10根香蕉 -

scripts.text: Ah! Bananas! Wow it's been a long time. She's pretty considerate isn't she?
scripts.translation: 啊！香蕉！哇，已经很久没吃了。她真贴心，不是吗？

scripts.text: Anyway is that all the business you have with me?
scripts.translation: 总之，这就是你要找我的所有事情吗？

scripts.text: Umm honestly I was wondering to find water lily and met you by coincidence. Jasira told me her sad story so that's what led me here.
scripts.translation: 嗯，说实话，我是想寻找莲花，偶然遇到了你。雅西拉告诉了我她的悲伤故事，所以我才来到这里。

scripts.text: As you can see, there are lots of Brasilis water lily around here.
scripts.translation: 如你所见，这里有很多巴西的莲花。

scripts.text: If you make sure that you won't destroy them you can appreciate them as you wish.
scripts.translation: 只要你保证不会破坏它们，你可以尽情欣赏。

scripts.text: Did you enjoy the water lily?
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
scripts.translation: 我忘了那种水果叫什么名字了...

scripts.text: I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
scripts.translation: 我忘了那种水果叫什么名字了...

scripts.text: Now I remember thank you very much. I can't remember the last time I had this fruit.
scripts.translation: 我想起来了，非常感谢。我已经很久没吃过这种水果了。

scripts.text: I guess I should keep my promise.
You can take one Water lily.
I hope the Brasilis water lily will understand me.
scripts.translation: 希望巴西的莲花能理解我的心意。

scripts.text: You better grab the flower while you have a chance~
scripts.translation: 趁现在还有机会，赶紧把花摘走吧~

scripts.text: Oh, can you tell that girl Jasira something for me?
scripts.translation: 哦，你能帮我告诉那个女孩雅西拉几句话吗？

scripts.text: Tell her that I am not the moon from the story, but I want to become the moon to shine only for her.
scripts.translation: 告诉她，我不是故事里的月亮，但我想成为月亮，只为她一人闪耀。

scripts.text: The flowers blooming from the Water lily today is wonderful.
scripts.translation: 今天从莲花上绽放的花朵真美。

scripts.text: An unusual Water lily is blooming here. You can't stop staring at it, knowing that few people have seen this flower bloom.
scripts.translation: 这里有一株罕见的莲花正在绽放。你知道很少有人见过它开花，所以忍不住一直盯着看。

scripts.text: - You can't avoid staring at it's beauty. -
scripts.translation: - 你无法移开视线，被它的美丽深深吸引。 -

scripts.text: There is a person who really needs this flower, can I just take one of 'em?
scripts.translation: 有个人非常需要这朵花，我可以摘一朵吗？

scripts.text: As I said earlier, I am the guardian of this water lily.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前所说，我是这株莲花的守护者。

scripts.text: I can't just stand by here and watch you pluck even a single flower from it.
scripts.translation: 我不能站在这里看着你从上面摘哪怕一朵花。

scripts.text: Hey man~ I brought these delicious fruits for you... try it! They are really well matured and fresh bananas.
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计~ 我给你带了这些美味的水果...尝尝看！它们非常成熟，是新鲜的香蕉。

scripts.text: - Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
scripts.translation: - 哦对了，我忘了带10根香蕉 -

scripts.text: Hmm... It's been so long since I've had this fruit.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我已经很久没吃过这种水果了。

scripts.text: I will just try one. That's all.
I remember my mom baking these into a tasty bread!

scripts.translation: 拿到这些材料后，我会用部落传承的秘密配方，为你制作一瓶能净化恶灵的药水。

scripts.text: The destiny of the tribe is up to you.
scripts.translation: 部落的命运就掌握在你手中。

scripts.text: Even at this moment, the village men are being seduced and slipping way...
scripts.translation: 此时此刻，村里的男人们仍在受诱惑，陆续离开...

scripts.text: Should I use a Purification Potion?
It's like getting cleansed of evil thoughts
At last I can forget the curse that I placed on myself when I drowned in the water.
scripts.translation: 终于，我可以忘掉自己溺水时施加在身上的诅咒了。

scripts.text: Do you think I can be born again as a kind water nymph?
scripts.translation: 你觉得我能重新转世为善良的水仙女吗？

scripts.text: Ah... Thank you for helping me recover my consciousness for a while.
scripts.translation: 啊...谢谢你让我暂时恢复了意识。

scripts.text: But... I think that the curse has been with me too long.
scripts.translation: 可是...这个诅咒伴随我太久了。

scripts.text: The curse is too strong for me to keep contained.
scripts.translation: 诅咒的力量太强了，我快要控制不住了。

scripts.text: Leave now while you are safe.

哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦。
啧！这是什么奇怪的声音？

scripts.text: Ah... the face I would never forget even in my dreams.
scripts.translation: 啊...那张脸，即便在梦中我也绝不会忘记。

scripts.text: When will she come out of the waterfall again...?
scripts.translation: 她什么时候才会再次从瀑布中现身...？
